findings.title: Admin delivery management is the only V1 visual surface (driver-side is API-only)
findings.description: Per the reference spec header: 'Livreur is API-only V1; visual = admin-side mgmt screens.' Driver-facing route /api/frontend/delivery-boy-order/* serves JSON for a future mobile/native client, no web UI. V1 acceptance therefore = admin /admin/delivery-boys + admin /admin/online-orders (where assignment occurs) ONLY.
findings.evidence: spec header (lines 1-2), no resources/js/pages/admin/delivery-boys/* Vue components found in routes.
findings.recommendation: Visual coverage = admin panels only. Driver UI = V1.0.2 mobile native scope.

findings.title: E2E spec uses fixed 1500ms waitForTimeout — non-deterministic on slow CI
findings.description: Each test uses page.waitForTimeout(1500) instead of waitForLoadState('networkidle') or a semantic selector wait. On a slow CI this may flake. Pattern consistent with the rest of the codebase E2E tests, not a heal target.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.2 backlog: switch to networkidle. Not gating.

findings.title: Error string 'Le montant minimum pour la livraison est de %.2f€' uses €
findings.description: OrderRequest.php:281 produces a hardcoded FR string with € symbol. Acceptable V1 (mono-FR), but i18n-roadmap should externalize to lang/fr/all.php. Not gating.

summary: Driver UI is API-only V1 — visual scope reduces to admin /admin/delivery-boys + /admin/online-orders. No P0/P1 UX heal targets surfaced. 2 P2/INFO deferred items.
